Date of service: 04/14/2025 | Dr. Jasper Grantham, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
37-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypertension, gastroesophageal reflux.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 18 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: rheumatoid arthritis with low disease activity, CDAI 4.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
